---
title: "Contacts cutover state"
description: "What exists for Contacts on Start + Void, what does not, and the Vercel rollback that stays in force."
updatedAt: "2026-11-09"
audience: developers
---

Contacts (`apps/contacts`) hosts tutoring workspaces that a customer uses daily.
Vercel remains its production runtime. This page records the state so that nobody
mistakes the candidate for a cutover-ready app.

## State

| Item | State |
| --- | --- |
| Native source | None for customer pages. `cloudflare/` holds the default-off [staging candidate](/build/devops/contacts-start-candidate): a fail-closed Worker whose only native route is the inert `/__contacts1` probe. Every page, route handler and asset is forwarded to a Next staging origin |
| Conversion | The [codemod](/build/devops/start-bridge-codemod) reports 40 of 40 pages on the generic adapter. It conflicts with the candidate's hand-written `vite.config.mts` and `cloudflare/worker.ts` (`--adopt` replaces them), so conversion is a separate change that retires the candidate and its CI |
| Production | Vercel, no Worker, no route, no DNS change. Last verified deployment source: `e970` (8 Nov), READY, anonymous homepage and login `200`. Customer record behavior is not verified |
| Reports | `/users/reports` stays on the Next build and must keep working through any future cutover |

## Cutover packet (not ready)

Do not attach a route for Contacts from the candidate. The candidate Worker answers
`503` unless `CONTACTS_START_CANDIDATE=staging` on the exact staging origin, and
forwards to Next, so it would add a hop in front of Vercel with no cost saving.
A real cutover needs the native conversion, the sealed artifact, signed-in staging
acceptance of tutoring, feedback, billing and `/users/reports`, and a production
profile (Worker name, host, bindings and secret names, as in
[Finance](/build/devops/finance-start-void)).

## Rollback

Nothing has been switched, so the production rollback is unchanged: the immutable
Vercel deployment already serving `contacts` stays in place. Any future cutover
captures the current Vercel deployment id, source SHA and DNS record before the
flip and rolls back by removing only the Contacts Worker route.

## Smoke (current Vercel production)

```bash
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://contacts.tuturuuu.com/        # 200
curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\n' https://contacts.tuturuuu.com/login   # 200
```

Signed-in checks of `/users/reports` use a disposable workspace, never customer data.
